author: Disney Channel YouTube
text:
Hudson and Casey's chaotic Not My Arms challenge 😂👋 | Disney Channel
Can Hudson Stone and Casey Trotter work together when they can't use their own arms?! Watch the Camp Rock 3 stars take on the Not My Arms Challenge as they team up to play instruments, make crafts, and more!

Camp Rock 3 is available on Disney Channel and Disney+.
https://www.disneyplus.com/whats-on/camp-rock-3

Watch the newest Disney Channel Videos here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLg6R6yXKSLYDR_VUUcVIxkjNd_ozPFwAU

Disney Channel castmates test their teamwork through challenges that require them to communicate and use each other’s arms in collaborative ways.
